9:  * @private
10:  */
11: 
12: var createError = require('http-errors')
13: var normalize = require('path').normalize
14: var resolve = require('path').resolve
15: var sep = require('path').sep
16: 
17: /**
18:  * Module exports.
19:  */
20: 
21: module.exports = resolvePath
22: 
23: /**
24:  * Resolve relative path against a root path
25:  *
26:  * @param {string} rootPath
27:  * @param {string} relativePath
28:  * @return {string}
29:  * @public
30:  */
31: function resolvePath(rootPath, relativePath) {
32:   var path = relativePath
33:   var root = rootPath
34: 
35:   // root is optional, similar to root.resolve
36:   if (arguments.length === 1) {
37:     path = rootPath
38:     root = process.cwd()
39:   }
40: 
41:   if (root == null) {
42:     throw new TypeError('argument rootPath is required')
43:   }
44: 
45:   if (typeof root !== 'string') {
46:     throw new TypeError('argument rootPath must be a string')
47:   }
48: 
49:   if (path == null) {
50:     throw new TypeError('argument relativePath is required')
51:   }
52: 
53:   if (typeof path !== 'string') {
54:     throw new TypeError('argument relativePath must be a string')
55:   }
56: 
57:   // containing NULL bytes is malicious
58:   if (path.indexOf('\0') !== -1) {
59:     throw createError(400, 'Malicious Path')
60:   }
61: 
62:   // path should never be absolute
63:   if (resolve(path) === path) {
64:     throw createError(400, 'Malicious Path')
65:   }
66: 
67:   // resolve & normalize the root path
68:   root = normalize(resolve(root) + sep)
69: 
70:   // resolve the path
71:   path = resolve(root, path)
72: 
73:   // path outside root
74:   if ((path + sep).substr(0, root.length) !== root) {
75:     throw createError(400, 'Malicious Path')
76:   }
77: 
78:   return path
79: }
